newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London on Wall St, currency.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London on Wall St, currency.

text.p: Japanese shares in London held overnight Tokyo gains as Wall Street continued to push ahead and currency movements continued to support stocks, traders said.
Shares edged higher through the session as the dollar rallied to another 33-month high against the yen, stirring renewed buying interest.
"The market's just pushing up. The dollar has been above 112 yen all day which has helped export stocks." said a trader.
"Generally there have been a few buyers around. We haven't been snowed under but with the currency and Wall Street opening in positive territory people are still optimistic."
